description: Get one item (question or stimulus) from a New Quiz (LTI) by its item_id, returning its position, points_possible, entry_type, and full entry body — including interaction_data and scoring_data, so the response reveals the correct answer. Find item_id with list_new_quiz_items, which also lists every item at once; use this tool only to refetch one item, such as right after create_new_quiz_item or update_new_quiz_item. assignment_id identifies the New Quiz (from list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment), not a Classic Quiz ID.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz

item_id.description: The New Quiz item ID (string, not numeric)

name: get_new_quiz_item
title: Get New Quiz Item
